tasks.label: Preview Benge Software website
tasks.command: python3 -m http.server 8000 --bind 0.0.0.0 & preview_server_pid=$!; trap 'kill $preview_server_pid 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; sleep 1; lan_ip=$(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1); echo "Local preview: http://localhost:8000/"; if [ -n "$lan_ip" ]; then echo "Home network: http://$lan_ip:8000/"; fi; open http://localhost:8000; wait $preview_server_pid
